meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Telegram 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Telegram 频道消息功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Telegram channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Telegram channel messaging to your application

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会获得将 Telegram 机器人集成到项目中的能力。它会复制 Telegram 适配器、配对辅助工具和测试文件，注册适配器，安装依赖包，并引导你完成机器人创建、配对和验证。
howto.when: 当你在项目设置中需要添加 Telegram 频道集成时触发。通常是在运行 `/setup` 或 `/manage-channels` 等命令时。

say.text: 帮我添加 Telegram 频道集成。
say.note: Claude 会开始执行添加 Telegram 频道的步骤。

say.text: 我需要创建一个 Telegram 机器人并配对。
帮我检查 Telegram 集成是否正常工作。
say.note: Claude 会运行测试并检查适配器状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude gains the ability to integrate a Telegram bot into your project. It copies the Telegram adapter, pairing helpers, and tests; registers the adapter; installs the dependency; and guides you through bot creation, pairing, and validation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to add Telegram channel integration during project setup, typically when running `/setup` or `/manage-channels` commands.

say_en.text: Help me add Telegram channel integration.
say_en.note: Claude will start the steps to add Telegram.

say_en.text: I need to create a Telegram bot and pair it.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through BotFather and pairing.

say_en.text: Check if the Telegram integration is working.
say_en.note: Claude will run tests and check adapter status.
